brief: The canvas depicts a gentle scene of whimsical, paper-cut ships sailing across a translucent medium. The ships are richly detailed, showing signs of age with subtle wood patina, visible moss, and barnacle buildup. As they sail and drift, their wake trails dissolve, leaving behind streaks of mineral and crystalline salt deposits. Over time, these mineral streaks form visible root-like structures that grow from the hulls, eventually causing sections of the paper to warp, tear, and detach into small, accumulating fragments that scatter along the bottom of the medium.

statement: This sketch depicts a whimsical underwater scene where aged paper-cut ships drift through a translucent medium, leaving behind mineral salt trails that grow into root-like structures over time. The ships are richly detailed with visible moss and barnacles, and as they sail, their wakes dissolve into crystalline streaks that gradually form organic root systems on the hulls. These root structures slowly cause sections of the ship hull to warp and tear away, leaving scattered fragments that accumulate at the bottom of the scene. The entire composition evolves organically without any user input, with ships moving independently, salt streaks dissolving, roots growing, and particles scattering naturally across the canvas.
